executive_summary.text: Contract (agency) staff made up 12.2% of nursing hours in 2026Q2 (Connecticut median 3.8%).
PBJ-based estimate was below the Connecticut total direct-care comparison point in 12 quarter(s): 2023Q2, 2023Q4, 2024Q1, 2024Q2, 2025Q1, 2025Q4, 2026Q1, 2026Q2.

Current ownership interests reported to CMS: SHELLY JACKSON (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); THEODORE JACKSON (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); SHELLEY L JACKSON (Direct Ownership Interest); THEODORE JACKSON (Direct Ownership Interest).

Current operational/managerial control reported to CMS: SHELLEY L JACKSON (since 10/01/1997); THEODORE JACKSON (since 10/01/1997); ANURUDDHA WALALIYADDA (since 11/01/2016); JOHN L CARON (since 04/06/2022); MICHELE D'AMICO (since 11/17/2011); SHELLEY L JACKSON (since 10/01/1997); THEODORE JACKSON (since 10/01/1997).
Cost year 2025: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $440,291, of which $258,861 is counted in direct care.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 6 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $37,903 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: RNs Administrative (page 10 line A12b2), removed $45,720; Operators Owners (page 10 line A1), added $11,500; Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $3,258. Separately, the home itself removed $273,111 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
